beats.text: It had rained in Sol for nine years. One man never got wet.
They called him Aura monster. Midnight, no coat, no hat, bone dry.
The shopkeepers said luck. The police said a trick. The kids said magic.
So one night I followed him. The rain stopped around me. Then I saw why.
He wasn't dodging the storm. He was holding it up, one walk at a time, so the city could sleep.
He turned, tired, and smiled. Your turn.
Now I walk these streets at midnight. And I never get wet.
